clips.description: Single bright small-dog bark, ~547 Hz fundamental. Trimmed from 0.92s of the source, high-passed at 180 Hz, denoised, loudness-normalised to -18 LUFS and peak-limited to -3.5 dBFS.

clips.speaker: callie
clips.transcript: She's a French Bulldog. She loves snacks, the lake, and me. In whatever order you want.
clips.license: Generated asset — Magnific/ElevenLabs voiceover, licensed to the project owner via their Magnific account.

clips.speaker: tay
clips.description: Excited puppy yip/whine, tonal ~547 Hz. Extracted from 37.55s of the source (the one clearly tonal vocalisation in an otherwise hiss-dominated night recording), band-passed 300-5000 Hz, +18 dB pre-gain, heavy spectral denoise, normalised and peak-limited.

clips.speaker: callie
clips.transcript: She's also never once known when something's wrong with her.
clips.license: Generated asset — Magnific/ElevenLabs voiceover, licensed to the project owner via their Magnific account.

clips.speaker: tay
clips.transcript: Huff! (i feel amazing! i always feel amazing!)
clips.description: Breathy dog huff/shake-off. Extracted from 76.30s of the source, band-passed 120-6000 Hz, denoised, compressed 4:1 to give the breath body, normalised and peak-limited. Intentionally softer than the barks — a huff is a low-energy sound.

clips.speaker: callie
clips.transcript: A couple summers ago, we drove out to the lake. It was a good day. Right up until it wasn't.
clips.license: Generated asset — Magnific/ElevenLabs voiceover, licensed to the project owner via their Magnific account.

clips.speaker: callie
clips.transcript: Tay had heat stroke. It almost killed her.
clips.license: Generated asset — Magnific/ElevenLabs voiceover, licensed to the project owner via their Magnific account.

clips.speaker: tay
clips.transcript: Woof! (i was having such a good day!)
clips.description: Single short woof, ~422 Hz fundamental — small/medium dog. Used whole (source is only 0.33s), high-passed at 180 Hz, normalised and peak-limited.

clips.speaker: callie
clips.transcript: You were. That was kind of the problem.

clips.speaker: callie
